a_before_b.rationale: Deciding whether to build or buy a foundation model does not require understanding why evaluating intelligent outputs is difficult; the build-versus-buy decision focuses on cost, control, and time-to-market rather than evaluation challenges.

b_before_a.rationale: Understanding why evaluating foundation models is difficult provides essential context for making an informed build-versus-buy decision, as evaluation difficulty directly affects cost, control, and time-to-market trade-offs.
